_how_to_use: Briefs for REAL creators — people who actually use Active AI. Everything here is optional direction, not a script. Creators know their own audience and format better than we do; the job of a brief is to make sure the facts are right and the legal line isn't crossed, then get out of the way. Send a creator one brief, not the whole file.
_never_send_to: The AI presenter cast (presenters.json). These are testimonial angles built on personal experience. A synthetic persona claiming to have used the app is prohibited outright, disclosure or not. AI presenters use the demo prompts in prompts.json instead.
_non_negotiables: The creator must genuinely use the app before posting about it. No exceptions — this is what makes the testimonial legal in the first place.
Paid or gifted relationships must be disclosed clearly and up front — a visible #ad or the platform's paid-partnership label, not buried at the end of a hashtag block.
Only their own real experience. They can't describe results they didn't get.
No specific-outcome promises, especially with timelines ('lose 15lbs in 30 days'). This is the single fastest route to both an ad rejection and a one-star review.
No medical claims. The readiness score and body scan are not diagnostics and must never be framed as medical advice.
Competitors can be referenced generically ('a $300 recovery ring') but not named disparagingly.
No claims about accuracy we can't substantiate — 'it's right every time' is a claim, 'it's matched how I felt' is an opinion.
_facts_creators_get_wrong: The readiness score is free on every tier, including free. It is not a paid feature.
There is no wearable requirement — it reads from Apple Health, whatever is feeding it.
Paid tiers are Starter $9.99, Pro $15.99, Elite $19.99 per month. Weekly and annual options exist; annual is cheaper per month.
Billing runs through the App Store / Play Store, so cancellation happens in phone settings, not in the app.
